text:
I tested 3 LLMs with Seedance inside Higgsfield Supercomputer

same brief : make a 2 min claymation kids cartoon where only fruits and vegetables exist and act like people

result was very clear

> Seedance = most prompt faithful video model
> Gemini 3.5 Flash = best creative direction
> Claude Sonnet = best at understanding user intent
> Gemini 3 = cheap + solid but trails on creative taste

Higgsfield Supercomputer routes the right sub-task to the right model

creative direction -> Gemini 3.5 Flash
intent parsing -> Sonnet
video execution -> Seedance
content: Route subtasks by model when using Seedance: use Gemini 3.5 Flash for creative direction, Claude Sonnet for intent parsing, and Seedance for final video execution to maximize prompt faithfulness.

translations.es:
---
Dirige las subtareas por modelo al usar Seedance: utiliza Gemini 3.5 Flash para la dirección creativa, Claude Sonnet para el análisis de intención, y Seedance para la ejecución final del video para maximizar la fidelidad al prompt.
---
translations.fr: Routage des sous-tâches par modèle lors de l'utilisation de Seedance : utilisez Gemini 3.5 Flash pour la direction créative, Claude Sonnet pour l'analyse de l'intention, et Seedance pour l'exécution finale de la vidéo afin de maximiser la fidélité au prompt.
translations.ja: Seedanceを使用する際のサブタスクのモデルによるルーティング：創造的な方向性にはGemini 3.5 Flashを、意図解析にはClaude Sonnetを、最終的なビデオ実行にはSeedanceを使用して、プロンプトの忠実性を最大化します。
translations.ko: Seedance를 사용할 때 모델별로 하위 작업을 라우팅하세요: 창의적 방향에는 Gemini 3.5 Flash를, 의도 분석에는 Claude Sonnet을, 최종 비디오 실행에는 Seedance를 사용하여 프롬프트 충실도를 최대화하세요.
translations.pt-BR: Roteie subtarefas por modelo ao usar Seedance: use Gemini 3.5 Flash para direção criativa, Claude Sonnet para análise de intenção e Seedance para execução final do vídeo para maximizar a fidelidade ao prompt.
translations.zh-CN: 在使用Seedance时按模型分配子任务：使用Gemini 3.5 Flash进行创意指导，Claude Sonnet进行意图解析，Seedance进行最终视频执行，以最大化保持prompt的忠实度。
